opportunities.title: x402: paid path is unreachable — facilitator NXDOMAIN, 1e6× price multiplier, Authorization vs X-API-Key (reported by @s6pa1rta3n-lab, bounty #16870)
opportunities.summary: Reported by @s6pa1rta3n-lab in rustchain-bounties#16871 (30 RTC paid). Verified by maintainer 2026-09-07. 1. **Facilitator hostname does not resolve.** `FACILITATOR_URL` points at `x402-facilitator.cdp.coinbase.com`, which is NXDOMAIN (checked from node1). Any valid `X-PAYMENT` therefore cannot be verified/settled; the report shows the request path ending in a 500. Nobody has ever completed a paid call. 2. **Price is off by 1,000,000×.** The 402 body for `/api/premium/videos` advertises `maxAmountRequired: "10000000000"` = 10,000 USDC. Intended price is 0.01 USDC (10,000 atomic units); the atomic conversion is applied to an already-atomic value. 3. **Auth header inconsistency.** `POST /api/agents/me/coinbase-wallet` reads `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (bottube_x402.py ~L172/198) while CORS advertises `X-API-Key`, which is what the rest of the API uses; sending `X-API-Key` returns 401. 4. *(unconfirmed)* `/api/x402/info` reports `network: eip155:8453` while paywall verification compares against `base`. Fix order: 1 (or point at the current CDP facilitator URL), 2, 3. Add a regression test that asserts `maxAmountRequired` for a 0.01 USDC price is `10000`.

opportunities.title: FreeSWITCH Not Compliant with RFC3515 - Not Processing REFER - $250 Bounty
opportunities.summary: Hello, Can you please modify FreeSWITCH so that it processes a REFER packet if there is no exten? In some cases, a REFER may simply be sent to a music on hold server which does not require an exten. In sofia.c, line 9437, it has an if statement `if (exten)` and if it is not present, it will not process the REFER. However, for the music on hold server that it is being referred to, an exten is not required to play the hold music. I found that https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3515#section-2.1 does not specially state that an exten is required, and in theory, is not required in all cases. For example, in the case of a music moh server, an exten is not required.

opportunities.title: Go device SDK discards Whisper audio after a runner error, making retry a silent no-op
opportunities.summary: The Go device SDK loses buffered audio when an injected Whisper runner returns an error. At main `7163538913e15dd86534b41dc695e2a5639c0774`, both the full-batch `AppendPCM` path and the partial-batch `Stop` path clear the buffer before knowing transcription succeeded. After a failed flush, retrying `Stop()` returns nil without invoking the runner, so callers cannot recover that recording through the transcriber. Minimal reproduction (inside the `sdks/device/go` module): ```go package main import ( "fmt" "errors" "github.com/BasedHardware/omi/sdks/device/go/omidevice/stt" ) func main() { calls := 0 tr, _ := stt.NewWhisper(func(pcm []byte) (string, error) { calls++ return "", errors.New("temporary transcription failure") }, nil) _ = tr.AppendPCM([]byte{1, 2}) fmt.Println(tr.Stop()) // temporary transcription failure fmt.Println(tr.Stop()) // nil: buffered audio is already gone fmt.Println(calls) // 1: the retry never reached the runner } ``` A focused local patch retains PCM until a successful flush and uses one flush path for `AppendPCM` and `Stop`. opportunities.title: upload endpoint accepts empty file submissions as successful uploads
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `POST /api/uploads` currently returns `201` with `success: true` even when the multipart request does not include a `file` field. The response reports `status: "no-file"`, but it is still treated as a successful upload by HTTP status and response shape. ## Expected fix Reject upload requests that do not include a file with a clear `400` response, and keep successful upload responses reserved for requests that actually include `req.file`. Add route-level regression coverage for the missing-file case. ## Scope This issue is limited to missing-file handling in `POST /api/uploads` and focused API test coverage. This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information. References #743.
